The plate looks like a square side or dinner plate, about 22-24 cm across. The cauliflower is a cluster of florets covering roughly 8 x 9 cm, with a few stray pieces. I estimated a height of about 3 cm for the main pile, which gives roughly 150 cm³ of florets. Allowing for air gaps and a density of about 0.45 g/cm³, that comes to about 70-90 g, plus about 10 g for the separate pieces. I settled on about 90 g in total.
